items.title: CloudOrbit launches Monday August 31, 2026
items.body:
CloudOrbit is now available — the AWS session manager you wish Leapp was.

## What's included

- **AWS SSO** — switch accounts without touching a config file
- **Auto-kubeconfig** — EKS clusters detected and written automatically
- **Session persistence** — active sessions survive app restarts
- **Region selector** — pick any AWS region per profile
- **IAM / Chained / Federated** — all auth methods supported
- **Cloudflare & corporate proxy** compatible

Free. Native Rust. No Electron.

items.title: Switch between AWS accounts in seconds
items.body:
Running multiple AWS accounts? CloudOrbit cycles through all active sessions in the sidebar every 5 seconds — click any indicator to jump directly to that session.

Use the region selector per profile to avoid switching regions manually in the terminal.
